operator_git_preflight: Run Git reads as SUDO_USER with GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0 so root activation cannot rewrite the operator-owned worktree index.
response_liveness: Controller now uses a bounded 120s root response timeout and keeps transport/GitHub failures in-process as TRANSIENT_ERROR instead of systemd crash looping.
transport_framing: Controller half-closes the Unix-stream write side after its one newline-delimited JSON request so root can complete its exact-one-object EOF check immediately.
